def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("red car")
    building_patches = image_patch.find("building")
    
    if not car_patches or not building_patches:
        return []
    
    # Sort buildings by their horizontal center
    building_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Get the rightmost building
    rightmost_building = building_patches[-1]
    
    # Filter cars that are to the right of the rightmost building
    near_cars = [car for car in car_patches if car.horizontal_center > rightmost_building.horizontal_center]
    
    return near_cars
